Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Securitatea computerelor și a rețelelor
REVELSI is a global cybersecurity, Al, software, and infrastructure services organization. We work with worldwide enterprises to design, build, secure, and operate the systems their business depends on.
Our top priority is safeguarding the fast-evolving global infrastructures and technologies.
We integrate cybersecurity into infrastructure development and operational processes, alongside software development and Al-driven products, to proactively stay at the leading edge of industry advancements.
REVELSI TEAM
At REVELSI, we combine deep technical expertise with a Silicon Valley-inspired mindset: agile, innovative, and collaborative.
We're a collaborative team that values performance and a positive work environment. We are committed to delivering high-quality results, supporting each other, and fostering a professional and friendly atmosphere.
We're looking for a team player with specialized skills, ready to grow and make an impact alongside experts in cybersecurity, network design, architecture, Al & software development, and IT management.
You'll collaborate with experienced IT (Security) professionals, expand your skills, and enjoy the journey in a team that embraces challenges with energy and enthusiasm.
YOUR IMPACT
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will design, secure, and maintain complex network infrastructures across on-premises and cloud environments, proactively optimize performance, and lead collaboration with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and implement best practices.
YOUR DAY-TO-DAY 
• Design, manage, and optimize network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments (Azure, AWS) 
• Configure and manage firewalls, VPNs, and IDS/IPS (Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems) 
• Monitor performance, proactively identify and troubleshoot network or security issues, and lead root cause analysis 
• Create network diagrams and maintain clear documentation 
• Assist and provide mentorship to junior
YOUR PROFILE
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology 
• 5+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience 
• Strong understanding of cloud networking: Azure (VNets, Load Balancers, Firewall, NSG, Application Gateway, DNS) and AWS networking (VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Security Groups, NACLs) 
• Proficient with firewall technologies (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco FTD); skilled in enterprise routing and switching 
• Deep knowledge of TCP/IP and core network protocols (BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, IPSec) 
• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, communication, teamwork, and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation
• CCNP/CCIE (or equivalent) certifications are a plus • Knowledge of tools such as Terraform, Ansible 
• Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices 
• Familiarity with container networking (Docker, Kubernetes, CNI plugins) 
• Understanding of microsegmentation (VMware NSX, Cisco ACI, or similar)
• Willing to work from Monday to Friday between 10:00 and 19:00 with 1 hour lunch break, in a hybrid system (4 days from our office)
WE VALUE OUR EMPLOYEES:
At REVELSI, we create an environment that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance:
• Private healthcare & medical insurance
• Private dental services
• Meal vouchers
• Referral bonus program
• Learning & development opportunities
• Team buildings & events
• Pizza day and free drinks at the office
• Seasonal gifts (Christmas / Easter)
• 21 days PTO, increasing up to 25 based on seniority
